purpose: Synthetic, non-customer corpus for Phase 0 cited extraction and action-review regression.
privacy: All names, domains, identifiers, and amounts are fictional. Do not treat this corpus as customer evidence.

actions.reason: do not infer a legal deadline

rules: Every asserted fact has an exact page citation.
Conflicts and missing evidence remain review states; they are never silently resolved.
Low-confidence critical clauses block action creation.
Duplicate imports are suppressed by a stable content identity.
External delivery failures produce a retry/review action and never claim success.
